svg.text: Make 2, identical. Plate 566 x 120 mm with four windows.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two halving slots 3.4 mm wide down from the top edge, 55 mm deep,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 238.5 mm each side of the centre line: the rails drop into them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each end: two tabs and a T-slot into the knuckle post's inner cheek.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the two plates cross the bed 25 mm apart under the box floor and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: carry the front wheels' load from one knuckle post to the other.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with both rails in the slots the top edges are level.
